lockedLook.pitch: Make the site look like your association: your own colours and fonts, shapes and feel on top of any theme, with a live preview, and drafts you can share by a private link before they go live.

siteDomain.locked: Your own website domain, such as www.yourassociation.org, is part of the Grove package. Your square works on its rootsquares address meanwhile.
siteDomain.pitch: Members and visitors find you at your own name, in the address bar, on posters and in e-mails. Your rootsquares address keeps working beside it. We add the domain for you; you only add one record at your domain provider.
siteDomain.talkTitle: Not sure it is for you?
siteDomain.talkBody: Tell us about your association and we will say what fits and what it costs.
siteDomain.lede: Use your own web address for the square. You add one record at your domain provider that points to {target}; we add the domain on our side and tell you by e-mail. Your rootsquares address keeps working.
siteDomain.hint: For example www.yourassociation.org. Use the www form: most providers cannot point a bare domain this way.
siteDomain.stateRequested: Waiting for us to add it
siteDomain.requestedBody: We add your domain on our side and tell you by e-mail when it is ready. You can add the record below now.
siteDomain.activeBody: Your square is served on this domain. Your address {address} keeps working as well.
siteDomain.recordTitle: Add this record at your domain provider.
siteDomain.recordBody: Create a CNAME for {domain} that points to the value below. Some providers want only the first part, for example www.
siteDomain.apexNote: A bare domain such as yourassociation.org cannot be a CNAME at most providers: use the www form, or ask your provider about a CNAME on the bare domain (it may be called flattening or ALIAS).
siteDomain.dnsPointing: Your domain leads to us. If the page does not open yet, we may still be adding it.
siteDomain.dnsNot: Your domain does not lead to {target} yet. A change at your provider can take a few hours to spread. Check the name and the value of the record.
siteDomain.dnsUnknownTitle: We could not see the record
siteDomain.dnsUnknown: The name does not answer yet. Add the record, wait a few hours, and check again.
siteDomain.removeAsk: The square stops being served on this domain. Remove it?

squareSettings.logoSub: Shown across your site. Drop a file onto a box or choose one.
squareSettings.mailHint: Contact-form messages, payment notices and replies to your site's mails arrive here. Not shown on your site; the public address is under Content, Contact details. Leave empty to use that one.
squareSettings.domainLocked: Sending your site's e-mail from your own domain (for example tickets{'@'}yourassociation.org instead of the shared rootsquares address) is included in the Grove package.
squareSettings.domainLede: Send your site's e-mail from your own domain. Optional: until then, mail goes out from the shared address and newsletters can't be sent.
squareSettings.domainHint: Use a subdomain, such as mail.yourassociation.org, so your normal e-mail stays untouched. Whoever looks after your domain must be able to add records for it.
squareSettings.domainLocalHint: Mail will be sent from {address}. Replies still go to your E-mail contact.
squareSettings.domainFrom2: . Replies still go to your e-mail contact.
squareSettings.domainRequestedBody: We'll set it up and e-mail you, usually within a working day. Then one step is left for you or whoever looks after your domain.
squareSettings.domainPending: Not used yet: mail still goes out from the shared address.
squareSettings.domainOneStep: One step left for you or whoever looks after {domain}: add four e-mail records at the domain provider.
squareSettings.domainWeb: Send the instructions to your web person
squareSettings.domainWebHint: We e-mail the records and plain steps. They don't change your website or normal mailboxes.
squareSettings.domainSent: Sent. We e-mail you when it works.
squareSettings.domainStep1: Add these where your domain is managed (your provider's DNS page). Copy each name and value exactly; names are relative to your main domain.
squareSettings.domainStep2: It can take minutes to hours before they're seen. If not seen within 72 hours it fails and we help you start again.
squareSettings.domainAuto: We check every hour and e-mail you when it's ready.
squareSettings.domainVerified: Your site's mail is sent from {address}.
squareSettings.domainRemoveAsk: Remove it? Your mail goes back to the shared address.
squareSettings.domainPitch: Your members then see mail from your own name, and it is more likely to reach the inbox. We set the domain up for you; you only add a few records at your domain provider. Until then your mail is sent from the shared rootsquares address with your square's name and your reply address.
squareSettings.domainHelpBody: We can do this with you for a small one-time support fee.
squareSettings.domainHelpThanks: We will write to your E-mail contact with what it costs and how we go on.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.pageLede: How your public site is used: visits, pages, where visitors come from, and how events turn into tickets.
analytics.lede: How your public site is used. Counted without cookies and without keeping who a visitor is; shown to you only.
analytics.offText: Counting is off. Nothing is counted about your site's visitors until you switch it on. When it is on you see visits, page views, where visitors come from and how events turn into tickets.
analytics.unreachable: Your site's server did not answer, so the numbers cannot be shown now. Try again in a minute.
analytics.resting: Your site is resting, so nothing is counted or shown now.
analytics.notCounting: Counting is switched on, but your site's server is not set up to count yet. This is set up by rootsquares; nothing is wrong with your site.
analytics.empty: No visits counted yet. They appear here after the next visit to your site.
analytics.chartLabel: Page views for each day of the period
analytics.visitorsNote: Visitors are counted once a day. Nobody is followed from one day to the next, so the visitors of several days are added up, not matched.
analytics.confirmTitle: Count the visits to your site?
analytics.countedText: which page was shown, which site the visitor came from, and how many different visitors there were each day.
analytics.notCountedText: no cookies, no names, no addresses, nothing that follows a person from one day to the next. A visitor who has Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control on is not counted. You and your admins are not counted. Small numbers are shown as "fewer than 5".
analytics.tell: It is good practice to say so on your privacy page: "We count visits to this site without cookies and without keeping who the visitor is."
